description: Contractual car allowance at the amount the employment agreement sets, prorated by the paid share of the month (unpaid days and part months reduce it); a fixed allowance, part of wages.
eligibility:
const agreed = get(ctx.subject.employment.terms, 'allowances.CAR_ALLOWANCE', null);
return agreed != null;

references.title: PP 36/2021
references.quote: Komponen Upah ditetapkan dalam Perjanjian Kerja, Peraturan Perusahaan, atau Perjanjian Kerja Bersama.
